title: Great sailing trip
text: We booked this for Easter Sunday and then found out the vineyard wasn’t open that day. The tour operator notified us as soon as she found out and we decided to just do the sailing trip. Our captain was Roman and he was great. We had a little hiccup with timing but they totally worked with us. Would highly recommend using this tour.
author: Catherine_M

title: Take me away
text: Very lovely sailing trip. Even though it rained, we had a great time. The capitan was so nice. The office staff was great too.  We highly recommend them. Would do this again
author: Val_C

title: Great experience at a 15th century era winery
text: Fantastic trip. Sailboat was amazing and the winery was perfect. The winery has been in the same family since the 15th Century.
author: Jamey_N
